title: Settle three Design v1.2 questions the way the tickets already lean?
bluf: Override of the prior-ruling gate: the gate matched only the word 'design'. Card composer-design-deploy is a different project (Composer) and hpsmpoc-telemetry-smaller-design-1022 is about telemetry. The nearest HPSM-POC ruling is your 29 Oct 10:43 option a, 'Build all except the three held pieces (gather those)': it held the Good/Better/Best packages page (HPSMPOC-392) and did not decide roles (390), the top-bar picker (391) or the menu labels; the analysis repo's design v1.2 record still lists 390, 391 and 392 as 'Not settled'. This card asks you to decide what that ruling left open. The design review left three product calls. (1) Roles: write a Partner/Consultant/Admin/Demo definition and do NOT add a Customer role or in-session role switch. (2) Customer switching: keep the top-bar picker, Back link and Open buttons as drawn. (3) Good/Better/Best: no packages page; keep the recommendation tiers as groupings; hold the labels 'Revenue and proposals' and 'Customer engagements'. Option A accepts all three. Default if you do not tap: option A, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10). Tickets: HPSMPOC-390, HPSMPOC-391, HPSMPOC-392

options.label: Go through them one at a time
options.detail: Tuesday sends them back as three cards.

default_action: Option A recorded as the product owner's ruling in the tickets' next records pass.
